purpose: Reusable examples and suggested defaults; public adapter types are authoritative.

formats.description: Explicit range and step; useful for fine scale adjustments

spring.description: Transition editor with switchable Time, Physics, and Easing modes

formats.description: Time mode - simpler, recommended for most cases
Physics mode - more control over spring behavior

spring.usage: Returns TransitionConfig (SpringConfig | EasingConfig), even when initialized as a spring. For Motion, convert type: 'easing' to { type: 'tween', duration, ease }; pass spring configs through.

formats.description: Basic action button using key as label

action.usage: Calls options.onAction with the full dot path, e.g. 'shadow.reset'. Wire real application handlers; actions are not writable values and setValues does not trigger them.

formats.example: size: { type: 'select', options: [{ value: 'sm', label: 'Small' }, { value: 'lg', label: 'Large' }] }
formats.description: Options with separate value and display label

select.usage: Returns selected value as string: params.theme

color.description: Color picker with Hex, OKLCH, Display P3, and alpha editing

formats.description: Auto-detects 3/4/6/8-digit hex, RGB, HSL, OKLCH, and Display P3. Use explicit color config for transparent; variables, named colors, relative colors, and calc() are not parsed.

color.usage: Returns a CSS color string; bind it directly instead of assuming hex. Timeline interpolation has narrower color support than this picker.

text.description: Text input that expands up to five lines, then scrolls; Enter adds a line break

formats.syntax: string (not detected as an absolute CSS color)

text.usage: Returns a string. Use explicit type: text to keep color-looking content as text.

formats.description: Start a folder collapsed. Use panel option defaultCollapsed for the entire panel.

folder.usage: Access nested values: params.shadow.blur. The _collapsed metadata is omitted at runtime.

easing.description: Cubic Bezier editor with draggable handles, text coordinates, and keyboard editing

formats.syntax: { type: 'easing', duration: number, ease: [number, number, number, number] }
formats.description: Duration in seconds and cubic Bezier coordinates; supports switching to Time or Physics spring mode

easing.usage: Returns TransitionConfig. Narrow on curve.type; convert easing to Motion's tween type at the rendering boundary.

image.description: Image selection, upload, and drop control

formats.syntax: { type: 'image', options?: (string | { value: string, label: string })[], default?: string }
formats.description: Defaults to the first option unless a default URL is supplied

image.usage: Returns a URL or local data URL, or an empty string when cleared. Uploads up to 10 MB stay in the browser. Guard empty values before rendering with the project image component; persisted data URLs are subject to storage limits.

pad.description: XY pad for editing a pair of related numbers

formats.syntax: { type: 'pad', x?: [default, min, max, step?], y?: [default, min, max, step?], labels?: { x?: string, y?: string } }
formats.example: timing: { type: 'pad', x: [0.3, 0.1, 1, 0.01], y: [0.2, 0, 1, 0.01], labels: { x: 'Duration', y: 'Bounce' } }
formats.description: Explicit axes without a step use (max - min) / 200. Values clamp and snap. Labels do not rename returned keys.

pad.usage: Returns { x, y }. X increases rightward and Y upward; negate spatial Y for CSS/Motion screen coordinates if movement should follow the pad. Update the pair with setValue('position', { x, y }), not separate paths.

typeDefinitions.SpringConfig: { type: 'spring'; stiffness?: number; damping?: number; mass?: number; visualDuration?: number; bounce?: number }
typeDefinitions.SelectConfig: { type: 'select'; options: (string | { value: string; label: string })[]; default?: string }
typeDefinitions.DialValue: number | boolean | string | SpringConfig | EasingConfig | ActionConfig | SelectConfig | ColorConfig | ImageConfig | TextConfig | DialPadConfig | DialPadValue
typeDefinitions.DialConfig: { [key: string]: DialValue | [number, number, number, number?] | DialConfig }
typeDefinitions.EasingConfig: { type: 'easing'; duration: number; ease: [number, number, number, number] }
typeDefinitions.DialPadConfig: { type: 'pad'; x?: DialPadAxis; y?: DialPadAxis; labels?: { x?: string; y?: string } }
typeDefinitions.DialKitPersistOptions: boolean | { key?: string; storage?: 'localStorage' | 'sessionStorage'; presets?: boolean }

spatialPad.description: Position pair with CSS/Motion Y negated at the binding

easingPreview.description: An easing curve with a position target; convert easing to Motion tween when binding

contentPreview.description: Editable text, wide-gamut color, and a local image choice
